article.story: SAN ANTONIO -- — Robert Brown III scored a career-high 37 points to lead Nicholls to an 88-82 victory over Incarnate Word on Monday night. Brown added seven rebounds for the Colonels (10-7, 4-2 Southland Conference). Jaylen Searles totaled 19 points, seven rebounds and three steals. Byron Ireland scored 13. The Cardinals (9-8, 2-4) were led by Davion Bailey with 22 points. Jordan Pyke had 20 points and six rebounds. Jalin Anderson had 20 points and four assists. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
